plugins.name: groundwork
plugins.description: Spec-driven workflow for Laravel backends: grounded discovery and specs before code, an anti-hallucination protocol for external integrations, and hooks that hold the runner, formatting, static analysis, tests and the OpenAPI document.

plugins.name: follow-through
plugins.description: Project-agnostic gates on how an agent ends its turn and how parallel sessions coexist: no stopping on an announcement, no prose questions, no handing work back, no 'it works' on unseen screens, plain outbound texts, a prompt before destructive commands, a shared registry so sessions see each other, lanes that start from the freshest integration branch, and a status file kept current in the same turn.

plugins.name: groundwork-pack
plugins.description: One-install bundle: groundwork plus the external plugins its steps reach for (php-lsp, context7, playwright, sentry) — deferred-MCP only, near-zero standing context cost.

metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Max Yastremskyi.
